title: Uganda: Africa’s longest-serving leader, Yoweri Museveni, seeks to extend 40-year rule
summary: In Uganda, millions prepare to vote in a presidential election steeped in tension and controversy. President Yoweri Museveni, Africa’s longest-serving leader, is seeking a seventh term in office, but his challengers and critics say the race is anything but free or fair. Story by Clarisse Fortuné.
